context: Remote software-development workshop with facilitators and learners.

scoringScale.5: Meaning is complete and natural; all important details and terms are preserved.
scoringScale.4: Meaning is clear with only minor wording issues; no important detail is lost.
scoringScale.3: Main idea is understandable, but one detail, term, or relationship is weakened.
scoringScale.2: Partially understandable, but multiple details or key terms are wrong or missing.
scoringScale.1: Unusable translation or transcription; meaning is mostly wrong or absent.

samples.englishSource: Please mute your microphone while your teammate is presenting.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 当你的队友正在演示时，请将麦克风静音。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if the translation clearly tells learners to mute the microphone only during the teammate's presentation; score lower if it implies muting permanently or omits who is presenting.

samples.englishSource: Open the shared document and add your notes under section two.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 请打开共享文档，并在第二节下面添加你的笔记。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if the target action and location are both correct; score lower if section two becomes page two, step two, or another location.

samples.englishSource: Use the chat if you have a question during the demo.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 如果你在演示期间有问题，请使用聊天功能。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if it preserves that questions should go through chat during the demo; score lower if it suggests speaking aloud or asking after the demo.

samples.englishSource: Take three minutes to test the login flow with your partner.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 请花三分钟和你的搭档一起测试登录流程。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if time, collaboration, and testing the login flow are all preserved; score lower if login is mistranslated as registration or if the time is missing.

samples.englishSource: When you finish, raise your hand and wait for feedback.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 完成后，请举手并等待反馈。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if the sequence is clear: finish first, then raise hand, then wait; score lower if the order is ambiguous or feedback is omitted.

samples.englishSource: The API returns a 401 error when the bearer token is expired.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 当 bearer token 过期时，API 会返回 401 错误。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if API, 401, bearer token, and expiration are all retained; score lower if 401 becomes 404 or the token cause is lost.

samples.englishSource: Check whether the React component re-renders after the state update.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 请检查 React 组件在 state 更新后是否重新渲染。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if the React/state/re-render relationship is accurate; score lower if it confuses rendering with refreshing the whole page.

samples.englishSource: We need to debounce the search input before calling the database.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 我们需要在调用数据库之前，先对搜索输入做 debounce。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if debounce is preserved as a technical behavior; score lower if it is translated as delay vaguely without linking it to the search input.

samples.englishSource: The migration adds an index on sessionId to speed up transcript queries.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 这个 migration 会在 sessionId 上新增索引，以加快 transcript 查询。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if index location and purpose are both correct; score lower if index is confused with identifier or if transcript queries are omitted.

samples.englishSource: If the promise rejects, show the validation message instead of crashing the page.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 如果 promise 被 rejected，请显示验证消息，而不是让页面崩溃。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if rejection handling and graceful validation display are preserved; score lower if it implies ignoring the error or retrying automatically.

samples.englishSource: Before we move to the next exercise, make sure your branch is up to date, your tests pass, and your screen is still shared.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 在进入下一个练习之前，请确认你的 branch 已经更新到最新、测试都通过，而且屏幕仍在共享中。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if all three checklist items are preserved; score lower for omitted items, especially tests or branch status.

samples.englishSource: I will give you one minute to read the error message, then we will compare what changed between the two commits.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 我会给你一分钟阅读错误消息，然后我们会比较两个 commits 之间改了什么。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if timing and the compare-between-commits task are clear; score lower if commits are translated as comments or if the sequence is wrong.

samples.englishSource: If your local server is still loading, pair with someone nearby and follow along from their browser for now.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 如果你的本地服务器还在加载，请先和附近的人配对，暂时从他们的浏览器一起跟上。
importantDetailsToPreserve: follow from their browser for now
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if the temporary workaround is clear; score lower if it suggests fixing the server instead of pairing and following along.

samples.englishSource: After you submit the form, watch the network tab and tell us whether the request returns JSON or redirects to another page.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 提交表单后，请观察 network tab，并告诉我们 request 是返回 JSON，还是重定向到另一个页面。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if both possible outcomes, JSON and redirect, are preserved; score lower if it only mentions one outcome or loses the network-tab context.

samples.englishSource: The goal is not to memorize the framework, but to notice the pattern: read the data, validate it, save it, and refresh the view.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 目标不是背下这个 framework，而是注意这个模式：读取数据、验证数据、保存数据，然后刷新视图。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if the contrast and four-step pattern remain intact; score lower if any step is omitted or framework is mistranslated as a physical structure.

samples.englishSource: Yuchi will review pull request number 117 after the 2:30 breakout.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: Yuchi 会在 2:30 的分组讨论后审查第 117 号 pull request。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if the name, number, time, and pull request are exact; score lower if the PR number or timing changes.

samples.englishSource: Maria, please paste the JWT into the .env file, not into Slack.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: Maria，请把 JWT 粘贴到 .env 文件里，不要粘贴到 Slack。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if the destination and prohibition are both correct; score lower if it suggests posting the token in Slack.

samples.englishSource: The bug appears only on Safari 18 when the API response takes more than 800 milliseconds.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 这个 bug 只会在 Safari 18，并且 API 响应超过 800 毫秒时出现。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if browser version and latency threshold are exact; score lower if it says all browsers or changes 800 milliseconds.

samples.englishSource: Ask Team Beta to rename the function from getUser to getSessionParticipant.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: 请 Team Beta 将函数名称从 getUser 改成 getSessionParticipant。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if both function names are exact and direction is correct; score lower if the old and new names are reversed.

samples.englishSource: The Redis cache key should include sessionId, learnerId, and zh-TW.
samples.expectedSimplifiedChineseMeaning: Redis 缓存 key 应该包含 sessionId、learnerId 和 zh-TW。
samples.suggestedAccuracyScoringRubric: Score 5 if all key parts and zh-TW are preserved exactly; score lower if any identifier is translated, dropped, or normalized incorrectly.
